decode: arg0=utf8
arg0 is RiotGamesPrivateSettings.yaml as src/main/launchers/riot/adapter.ts reads it (readSessionFile: readLauncherText, readFileSync then toString utf8; a BOM stays as U+FEFF and is handled by the function, invalid bytes become U+FFFD). In the app it is called by planSignOut on that text, and by the fake client (sim/riot.ts fakeSessionFile) on its template.
arg1 is the block body: null for the signed-out state, else the lines to put under riot-client: (each indented four spaces past it). It is not file text.
Lines split on \r?\n; a line counts as blank by JS String.prototype.trim (U+FEFF is blank, U+0085 is not); indent counts U+0020 only; KEY_LINE has no u flag, so its `.` stops at a lone CR, U+2028 and U+2029 and such a line is no key.
Coverage: every block ran; the BOM arm of splitLines (session.ts:149, the U+FEFF literal) is listed as not measured because the transform rewrites the literal, and the bom cases run it.
The output keeps a leading BOM and every untouched line as it was, but joins all lines with one line end: CRLF when the input holds any CRLF, else LF; so a mixed file comes back all CRLF (mixed-eol).
Errors: "no <path> block" for the first missing key on psl.authorization.riot-client.
The corpus (corpus-*): seeds on the generated bases under l1/riot/files/spliceSessionBlock/ take every mutation; seeds on the two fixtures take line mutations, EOL and BOM only, so that every token in an output is the fixture's own placeholder.
